entanglement.description: Extension loading depends on importlib metadata entry points, plugin load failures, duplicate names, lazy name lookup, and callback semantics.
signals: Entry points are filtered by namespace before loading.
Load failures are swallowed only after invoking the failure callback.
Duplicate names are resolved lazily by a conflict resolver.
map can either ignore or propagate extension callback exceptions.

feature.description: Extract a task-scoped Stevedore-style ExtensionManager for dynamic entry point discovery and loading.
included_behaviors: NamedExtensionManager filtering, missing callback, and requested order
feature.name: ExtensionManager entry point discovery and loading
